messages:
alexander: FYI found a regression in tokenizer that causes rare token boundary drops in eu-west1 (seen ~0.18% requests). patch ready: 1.2.3-hotfix.

maya: Oof. Is this impacting latency or correctness?

alexander: correctness mainly — some truncation on long prompts, not a full outage but customers noticed. We should hotpatch.

sanjay: ETA for build? can we hotfix without full canary?

alexander: build ready. 12:00 UTC burst window available for expedited hotfix. Plan: pin traffic to existing variant, deploy hotfix to a small reserved pool, smoke, then shift 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m holds. If metrics look bad rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy request received. Command: `/deploy service=tokenizer env=eu-west1 version=1.2.3-hotfix canary=0`

jun: we need 2 approvers from eng-releases + oncall ack to skip standard 30m canary. ops-oncall: are you ok with fastpath?

ops-oncall: I can take oncall during window. Need rollback criteria: error rate >0.5% OR avg tokens/sec drop >20% for 3 consecutive mins -> immediate rollback. Also preserve previous model shard for instant pin.

maya: Reviewing diffs now. No risky op kernels. I approve to expedite. :thumbsup:

lee: I approve — hotfix looks narrowly scoped. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Just to confirm, are we doing zero-canary (canary=0) or small-canary (10%)?

alexander: we'll start with reserved pool smoke (no public traffic) then roll 20% after 2m if smoke ok. deploy-bot will handle weights.

deploy-bot: Starting deploy to reserved GPU pool (eu-west1-reserved-02). Smoke tests: running (endpoint /health, small prompt suite).

deploy-bot: Smoke tests passed. Applying traffic shift: 0% -> 20% (timestamp 2065559908).

ops-oncall: Monitoring. Setting alert: anomalies channel if error rate >0.25% so we can respond early.

alexander: seeing no error uptick, latency steady. Proceeding to 50%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift to 50% completed (timestamp 2065559934).

maya: quick QA — ran 10 prompt regressions, looks fine.

ops-oncall: still nominal. No metric spikes.

alexander: final 100% shift in 5m if no issues.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift to 100% completed (timestamp 2065559978). Release notes draft: "hotfix 1.2.3-hotfix — fixes tokenizer boundary regression in eu-west1; rolled out 2065559978; rollback criteria used: error rate >0.5% or tokens/sec drop >20%."

lee: Adding rollout note to release doc and tagging customers who reported it.

sanjay: Great. Closing expedite. Recommend postmortem doc w/ root cause and test added to CI.

alexander: Agree — I'll open a short postmortem and add a unit/regression test. Thanks all for quick approvals :rocket:

ops-oncall: Marking incident as mitigated. Leaving monitoring for 24h.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. All services healthy.
